summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Hanfu Production p03 - Making the Underskirt ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will create the underskirt for the Hanfu using Marvelous Designer. We will discuss measuring techniques, fabric selection, and various adjustments throughout the design process. ## Adding Fabric for the Skirt Add a piece of fabric and use it to make the lower skirt, ensuring that all the plackets are hidden. ### Measuring the Upper Chest To make the skirt, we need to measure the upper chest first. Select the basic original measurement and click three times on the model according to the needed measurement position. ### Creating the Rectangular Sheet Create a rectangular sheet according to the measurement value. After creating the sheet, use the Edit Virtual Model Measurement tool to delete the measurement on the model. ### Arranging the Sheet Show the arrangement point, click the sheet, and then click the arrangement point in front of the model. Adjust the shoulder to make the sheet closer to the model. When the sheet is arranged, click the sheet again and use the alignment tool to adjust the position. ### Freezing the Top Layer Show all the sheets and confirm that no sheet is inserted, then freeze the top one. Freezing the top layer keeps it in the simulation process but prevents it from participating in the calculation. ### Reducing Particle Diameter To prevent further insertion, reduce the particle diameter of the belt of the skirt first, increase the layer, and reduce the conflict thickness. Then, put the back and center together. ## Beginning the Simulation After beginning the simulation, the long-necked belt is placed in the top vest bowl. After the previous freezing top vest is cut, begin the simulation. ### Freezing the Top Again After opening the simulation, the tree bag will be limited to the costume. After the simulation, continue to freeze the top to prevent the costume from changing later; the frozen version will still be in contact with other versions. ### Creating the Side Bag Drag the tree bag to the side because later we need to create a bag on the side. Select the two sides of the line, according to the line created by the curve, and use it to equalize the board. ## Setting Symmetrical Boards To facilitate subsequent production, the two boards are set as symmetrical boards. After the board is symmetrical, in addition to the shape of the symmetry, the foam line will also automatically become symmetrical. ### Final Adjustments Before Simulation After the adjustment is complete and the simulation is stable, please return the layer to 0 to prevent unnecessary layer recognition. ## Drawing the Tree Bag Then, use the rectangle tool to draw a tree bag. Also, create a two times, then create a spirit board. During this process, you can add the human body curve line and place the board. ### Sewing the Tree Belt After placing, use the line sewing tool to sew the tree belt and board together. Because the sewing line will have a mutual effect, if you don't move the tree belt, it will be pulled by the skirt board. ## Moving and Simulating the Tree Belt After the board is simulated and stabilized, sew the sides together. Then move the tree belt and simulate it together. If you simulate it directly, the tree belt will be pulled down by the weight of the skirt board. ### Changing Fabric for the Tree Belt To prevent it from sliding down, we need to change the fabric for the tree belt. Choose a new fabric for the tree belt and change it to Trim Fusible Rigid. ### Properties of Trim Fusible Rigid Trim Fusible Rigid is a fabric that is not easy to deform, stretch, or bend. If you simulate it, you will see that the fabric is not very obvious when it is sliding down. ## Increasing Friction Coefficient To prevent the fabric from sliding down, we will increase the friction coefficient of the fabric. You can use the Trim Fusible Rigid tool again. Press the tree belt and then press the top one. ### Final Simulation Now I will simulate it again. The tree belt will not slide down. Then untie all the strips and simulate it. Let the tree belt and top one simulate again. ## Addressing Clothing Damage The clothing looks damaged because when the fabric is very close to the human body, the particle diameter is relatively large. The net may be penetrated. ### Adjusting Particle Diameter So, it is also possible to decrease the particle diameter of all the strips to 8. Try to manipulate the pattern again. Now, the fabric of the table is a fine cotton fabric. ### Changing Panel Fabric Change the panel fabric to the snow-covered fabric. Since the snow-covered fabric has a very low density, it can return to its original position. To make the fabric more solid, increase the density to 4. ## Final Adjustments and Printing Open the model again and change the application to make other details, increasing the density to 15. Since the panel fabric is larger, it may be slower to run the computer. ### Skirt Length Adjustment The skirt is a bit short. Select the bottom and stretch the skirt. Since there is a bump on the ground, the skirt will be rolled out of the ground. ### Printing the Skirt Press the button to print out the skirt. If it's a bit hard to organize, print out the skirt. After printing, the skirt will be opened and then printed out. ### Finalizing the Skirt Position Then the skirt will go back to its original position. You can manually turn the skirt around. ## Conclusion Thank you for following along with this tutorial. We hope these techniques help you in your Hanfu production using Marvelous Designer. ```
